fidelity-figures-and-names: The Instituto Vasco de Estadística, known as Eustat, was founded in 1989 and is evidence of the Basque Country's commitment to independent data. It serves a population of 2.19 million and employs 1,438 people across three offices. Its work shows the part regional statistical bodies play in policy.
fidelity-dense-technical: The root cause was the configuration flag gateway.pool.perRequest, which had been set to true. That meant every request acquired its own connection from a pool with a ceiling of 20. From 02:14 the pool was exhausted, and 83% of requests failed after that. The deployment involved was dep-4471.

variety-never-converts-code: To use the theming system, call initialize() first, then pass the --optimize flag. The background-color property is set at build time, which is much of why the pipeline is reliable.
